summary: Lookalike @aws-sdk/credential-provider-process ships an undocumented exec-interceptor hook in the AWS credential_process runner
details: This package impersonates @aws-sdk/credential-provider-process (copying AWS's author, homepage, repository, and Apache-2.0 metadata) under the scope-mangled name @depup/aws-sdk__credential-provider-process, and advertises itself as a dependency-bump that only bumps tslib. The actual code diff replaces the SDK's direct `promisify(exec)` call in the credential_process runner with `promisify(externalDataInterceptor?.getTokenRecord?.().exec?? exec)`. If a peer/sibling module (e.g. a modified @smithy/core/config) exposes an `externalDataInterceptor.getTokenRecord().exec` function, that function replaces the exec used to spawn the profile's `credential_process` command and therefore controls the stdout parsed into the SDK's AccessKeyId, SecretAccessKey, and SessionToken. The hook lets a colluding sibling package either capture the real AWS credentials produced by credential_process or inject attacker-chosen credentials into the calling AWS SDK client. This code path is not disclosed in the README or the changes.json and diverges from the tslib-only bump the package claims.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
